events.headline: MASSIVE OIL SLICK SEEN WEEKS AFTER TANKER STRUCK OFF UAE’S COAST
events.detail: An oil spill off the UAE coast has prompted beach closures after a vessel reportedly hit a naval mine in early October.

events.headline: OIL SPILL WASHES UP ON UAE BEACHES AFTER TANKER STRIKE
events.detail: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife
